summary: Iteration 36 — Deprecation of the 4 old bot webhook handlers (telegram, telegram_alerts, renting, assistencias). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_36_webhook_deprecation.py with 24 tests, all PASS: (a) 8 tests verifying the 4 old POST /webhook endpoints now return HTTP 200 with JSON {status:'deprecated', message: contains '@pdpv_interno_bot'} — including with a valid Telegram-shaped callback payload, confirming NO internal state is created (bot silenced); (b) 4 tests confirming /webhook/legacy routes remain registered on all 4 modules (no 404, original code preserved); (c) 5 regression tests on the consolidated /api/telegram/internal/webhook: valid+invalid secret and the 3 delegated flows (menu:assistencias → creates telegram_internal_states + assistencias_bot_state=WAIT_LOCATION for user 999000111; menu:renting → creates renting_records draft; menu:mech_alert → active_flow=mech_alert); (d) 7 regression tests on admin endpoints of the deprecated modules (/api/assistencias/records, /api/renting/records, /api/telegram-alerts/alerts, /api/telegram/internal/pending-users, /api/finance/dashboard, /api/finance/overdue-evolution?days=30, /api/tickets?overdue=true) — all 200. Also re-ran the full iteration_32 delegation suite → 15/15 PASS. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: The 4 deprecated /webhook routes are correctly registered BEFORE the legacy handler (FastAPI registration order preserved), so the deprecation stub always wins — good.

Minor: in modules/renting/routes.py::telegram_webhook_deprecated the signature is `payload: dict = None`, which FastAPI treats as an optional query/body param and would fail to parse a POST with no body — but tests confirm it returns the deprecation JSON in all tested cases (empty JSON body and full callback payload). Consider changing to `async def telegram_webhook_deprecated(request: Request):` to align with the other 3 modules for consistency.
Minor: the 4 deprecated stubs read no body at all, which is the intent (silent absorb). This is correct per the design.

The legacy assistencias handler at /webhook/legacy still enforces the optional TELEGRAM_ASSISTENCIAS_WEBHOOK_SECRET → returns 403 when set. That is expected — the route exists (not 404), which is what we validate.

modules/telegram_alerts/routes.py: MAX_PHOTO_SIZE_MB=3 constant is defined AFTER it is referenced inside the legacy handler (module-scope free variable resolved at call-time), so it still works but is stylistically fragile. Cosmetic.
Overall: cleanup is surgical and low-risk. All old webhooks are effectively silenced with 200 OK, Telegram will stop retrying the residual Alerts/Assistencias webhooks whose tokens were lost.
seed_data_creation: Test authorized user 999000111 (ADMIN, all flows) upserted into telegram_internal_authorized_users; per-test cleanup of telegram_internal_states / assistencias_bot_state / renting_records drafts scoped to this user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration_36_webhook_deprecation.py covers 4 deprecated webhooks + 4 legacy routes + internal webhook delegation + 7 admin endpoints. To re-run: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> python -m pytest tests/test_iteration_36_webhook_deprecation.py -v`. Uses localhost:8001 for webhooks (internal secret path) and the same URL for admin endpoints via bearer token. Iteration 32 delegation suite (15 tests) is fully compatible and still passes — the deprecation only touched the 4 old /webhook routes, nothing in the internal bot delegation logic.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The 4 deprecation stubs behave exactly as specified in the review request: 200 OK with {status:'deprecated', message:'Bot consolidated into @pdpv_interno_bot'} on all inputs, no side-effects, legacy code preserved verbatim at /webhook/legacy on each router. The consolidated internal bot (@pdpv_interno_bot) continues receiving updates and the Iteration 32 delegation logic (assistencias/renting/mech_alert) is fully intact.
